Sage ladder -- the game's only WORLD chat channel: the typed answer reaches every player on the server as "[name]: text". `duration` is the aether. AETHERS ARE ARCHIVE, NOT RTK -- 15/10/10/5/5 minutes, agreed independently by the nexusatlas sage page (2002-12-25), the nexusatlas 6.5 map page, the tutor-board post 'The sage spells' and tswolf's spell list (rung 1). RTK's sage.lua ran 15/10/5/2.5/1, which made the top rung FIVE TIMES faster than retail. MANA: tswolf prices Share Wisdom at 600, no source ever varies mana per rung, and every source describes the upgrade as buying AETHER and nothing else -- so all five carry 600 and RTK's ascending 10/50/100/250/300 is discarded (its rung 1 was 60x too cheap). Taught only by npcs.SageNpc in npc_dialog.lua. REACH: `sage_shout` gates on where the caster stands -- rungs 1-2 from the designated areas only, 3-4 also from their own kingdom, 5 from anywhere -- and outside its reach the spell becomes Mentor, charged the same. See docs/common/Deferred-Work.md.

Amnesia (Spells/rogue/amnesia.lua): 15 min on a normal mob, 5s on a boss (RTK's own isBoss branch -> durationMax). Wipes YOUR threat and blocks you as a target until it lapses or you hit the mob again. Needed a row because its spell_effects archetype had it extracted as Debuff/'slow', which is not what the script does. chance is the take-hold %: a miss just shakes off, no status/re-cast lock.

Confuse (Spells/mage/confuse.lua): a chance-based aggro RESET, NOT a debuff and NOT Amnesia's per-caster peel. Success wipes the mob's whole threat table and, if a creature stands on an adjacent tile, turns it on that creature (blind two side by side and spam Confuse -> they fight each other). No status, so it never says 'already cast'; a miss still spends mana. row.chance = take-hold %.
